name: Auto-Expand Prompt
description: Turns a terse prompt into a fuller one before it reaches the agent, using a side model, so you get a considered answer without having to write a considered question. Off until you flip the toggle in the composer; also available as a slash command, with the expander model configurable.

composer_controls.label: Auto-expand prompt
composer_controls.description: Before each message is sent, a model rewrites it into a clearer, more effective prompt and sends the improved version instead.

slash_commands.description: Expand and send an improved version of this one prompt, e.g. '/expand fix the login bug'. Works without the toggle.

turn_hooks.code: const input = (ctx.input || '').trim(); if (!input) { return { kind: 'none' }; } const onDemand = input.indexOf('/expand ') === 0; const toggled = !!(ctx.flags && ctx.flags['@ryu/auto-expand']); if (!onDemand && !toggled) { return { kind: 'none' }; } const target = (onDemand ? input.slice(8) : input).trim(); if (!target || target.indexOf('/') === 0) { return { kind: 'none' }; } const system = 'You are a prompt engineer. Rewrite the user message into a clearer, more specific, well-structured prompt that gets a better answer from an AI assistant. Preserve their intent and every concrete detail, constraint, example, and formatting request they gave. Do not answer it, and add no preamble or commentary. Return ONLY the improved prompt text.'; const improved = await host.sideModel({ system: system, prompt: 'Improve this prompt:\n\n' + target, model_pref_key: 'auto-expand-model', effort: 'low' }); if (!improved || !improved.trim()) { return { kind: 'none' }; } return { kind: 'replace', text: improved.trim() };

permission_levels.label: Can auto-expand
permission_levels.description: Let this app rewrite a short prompt into a fuller one before it is sent.
